spec.scope: Ally-protective utility: immunity to 1 debuff per application, 5s window, 3 activations per battle, gated 'while not in Defiant Spirit' (self-cooldown re-arm).
spec.durationSemantics: 5 sec wall-clock per activation; hard cap 3 activations per battle (a battle-scoped charge count, not a duration).
spec.triggerIdentity: fullCharge maintained >=1 sec, gated on NOT currently in Defiant Spirit (noRetriggerWhileActive shape). NOT shotFired; the 1s-hold clause is a charge-hold condition.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipping it with no audit trail — or, subtler, modeling Sky's own skill2 Low Tension ATK ▼ while ignoring that this immunity exists in-kit precisely to eat that debuff (tandem rule #4).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No block in the override emits any effect for this line; the override's unmodeled.skill1 carries it verbatim. No buffApply with an immunity-like stat exists (schema has no immunity primitive).
spec.inertness: Must move NOTHING: no damage, no buffApply, no resource. Pure unmodeled record.

spec.scope: Self attacks become Pierce-tagged for the window — this is what makes BOTH pierce-damage buffs (own 60%, burst 15%) live on her hits.
spec.durationSemantics: 40 sec wall-clock (durationSec:40 on a gainPierce effect), refreshed per qualifying full charge — near-permanent uptime given SR cadence (chargeFrames 60), but NOT whole-fight by construction.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullCharge (proxy for 'Full Charge maintained 1+ sec'). ⚑ the 1s-hold residue is a convention the sim's release-at-full-charge model cannot literally express; recipe: footage of auto-play charge-hold cadence vs first proc time.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Top-level hasPierce:true (static whole-fight flag) instead of a gainPierce effect on the fullCharge block — the exact boolean-vs-step-gate trap the schema calls out.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: gainPierce effect with durationSec 40 sits on a skill1 fullCharge-triggered block and override.hasPierce is falsy; damage events before the first full-charge pull resolves carry no pierce tag (pierceDamagePct contributes 0 to them), green under faithful, red under static hasPierce.
spec.inertness: Allies' pierce state must not change — the grant is self-only.

spec.scope: pierceDamagePct — Damage-Up bucket entry read ONLY by Pierce-tagged hits; live on Sky's hits only inside the paired gainPierce window.
spec.durationSemantics: 40 sec wall-clock, refreshed per qualifying full charge; co-terminal with the pierce grant.
spec.triggerIdentity: Same fullCharge block as the pierce grant (one ■ header, two effect lines).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Generic attackDamagePct 60 (unscoped Damage Up), or target allies — either over-credits: the buff must be dead weight on any non-pierce hit and on every teammate.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'pierceDamagePct', value:60, caster==target==Sky} after the first full charge; totals(res) for every OTHER slug is byte-identical when this effect is stripped via withPatchedOverride (allies unaffected), while Sky's own total drops.
spec.inertness: Ally damage totals; Sky's damage during any frame where she is not pierce-tagged.

spec.kitLine: ATK ▲ 20% of the skill user's ATK, 10s
spec.scope: Caster-scaled flat ATK add to the whole team — the classic supporter line; generic (not attack-type-scoped).
spec.durationSemantics: 10 sec wall-clock per Full Burst entry.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'when entering Full Burst' fires on ANY team FB, not only rotations Sky bursts (burstCast would under-fire whenever another B1 completes the chain, and Sky's own 40s burst cd makes that divergence real).
spec.nearestWrongModel: stat atkPct 20 (each target's OWN ATK) instead of casterAtkPct — over-credits a high-ATK carry since the kit scales off Sky's supporter ATK; second-nearest: trigger burstCast, halving uptime.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: At every fullBurstStart event a buffApply {stat:'casterAtkPct'} lands on each ally with value == 0.20 × Sky.staticAtk — the SAME flat number on every target (flat-resolved at apply). Under the atkPct misread the emitted stat/key differ and the carry's gain scales with its own ATK.
spec.inertness: No application outside FB entries; value must not track targets' ATK.

spec.kitLine: Low Tension: ATK ▼ 10% of user's ATK 20s
spec.scope: A team-wide MALUS (negative caster-scaled flat ATK) — damage-relevant in the wrong direction; also opens the named 'Low Tension' self-state the stun line gates on.
spec.durationSemantics: 20 sec wall-clock. Fires each time High Tension lapses: burst cd 40s vs High Tension 35s guarantees a lapse every cycle (steady-state: team ATK ▼ for ~20 of every ~40s).
spec.triggerIdentity: selfStatusEnd {name:'High Tension'} — fires on the frame Sky's own burst-opened High Tension window lapses. NOT fullBurstEnd (FB ends ~10s after entry; High Tension ends 35s after her CAST — different frames), and NOT an interval.
spec.durationNote: requires the burst to also author selfStatus 'High Tension' 35s on Sky, else this trigger can never fire
spec.nearestWrongModel: Omitting the line as 'defensive/edge-case flavor' (a debuff on your own team is easy to wave off), or keying it to fullBurstEnd — both erase/mistime a recurring ~10%-of-caster-ATK team-wide dip.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: At t ≈ (Sky's burstCast frame + 35s) — NOT at any fullBurstEnd frame — a buffApply with stat 'casterAtkPct' and NEGATIVE value == -0.10 × Sky.staticAtk lands on all allies; team totals over the following 20s are lower than with the effect stripped.
spec.inertness: Must not fire while High Tension is live (recast before lapse = window moved, no proc); must not scale off targets' own ATK.

spec.scope: SELF stun — no fire/charge/reload for 20s (bursting unaffected per engine). Zeroes Sky's own normal/charge output, her S1 re-triggering, and her gauge contribution for the window. Offensive-relevant despite 'stun' wording.
spec.durationSemantics: 20 sec wall-clock, coextensive with the Low Tension state. ⛑ Whether re-entering High Tension (her next burst at lapse+5s) cancels Low Tension and ends the stun early (effective ~5s, not 20s) is kit-silent — a ×4 swing on her downtime. Literal reading: full 20s. Recipe: footage of her fire resumption after the burst recast.
spec.triggerIdentity: 'Activates only when in the Low Tension state' = fires on Low Tension ENTRY — same frame as the selfStatusEnd('High Tension') block, authored either on that trigger or gated requiresSelfStatus:'Low Tension'.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropping the stun entirely as defensive flavor — over-credits Sky's personal output by up to ~50% uptime (20s stunned of every ~40s cycle under the literal reading).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Zero 'shot' events (and zero reload events) with srcSlot==Sky in [lapseFrame, lapseFrame+20s] via cfg.onEvent, while her burstCast at lapse+~5s still occurs; shots resume after the stun. Red under the dropped-stun model (shots continue through the window).

spec.scope: Team pierceDamagePct — only moves Pierce-tagged hits (Sky's own inside her S1 window; a pierce carry's always). Additive with Sky's own 60% in the same bucket.
spec.durationSemantics: 35 sec wall-clock, maxStacks 3 — but burst cd 40s > 35s duration means stacks can NEVER accumulate in practice: author maxStacks:3 with value 15, steady-state 1 stack. Also opens the 'High Tension' named self-status (selfStatus, 35s, on Sky) that skill2's removal trigger reads.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (her OWN burst block — fires only on rotations Sky casts), NOT fullBurstEnter. With another B1 in the comp they diverge; keying to fullBurstEnter over-credits.
spec.nearestWrongModel: value 45 pre-stacked (15×3 'stack-cap product' fudge) — triple-credits a cap the 40s cooldown makes unreachable; second-nearest: fullBurstEnter trigger; third: forgetting the paired selfStatus, which silently kills the entire Low Tension loop (skill2 blocks never fire — a conveniently flattering omission).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'pierceDamagePct', value:15, maxStacks:3, stacks:1} on each ally at Sky's burstCast frames only; stacks never exceed 1 across the whole run; AND a later selfStatusEnd-driven skill2 proc exists (proving the selfStatus was authored).
spec.inertness: Non-pierce allies' totals must not move when this buff is stripped; no application on FBs Sky did not cast.

spec.scope: Plain self ATK percentage — scales her OWN ATK (stat atkPct), feeding her normals, charge damage, and any caster-ATK-scaled grants she emits (her skill2 casterAtkPct resolves off staticAtk at apply, so verify which basis the engine uses — buffApply values snapshot staticAtk per the harness note, so this does NOT inflate her team grant).
spec.durationSemantics: 35 sec wall-clock — near-full uptime vs the 40s cooldown (5s gap each cycle, coinciding with the Low Tension window).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Target allies (bleeding a 50% ATK buff onto the carry — large over-credit), or casterAtkPct 50 (flat basis instead of percentage).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'atkPct', value:50, casterIdx==targetIdx==Sky} at her burstCast frames; stripping it via withPatchedOverride changes totals(res)['sky'] only — every other slug's total is unchanged.

skill1: Defiant Spirit: Grants debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s) for 5 sec. Activates 3 time(s) per battle.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of likelihood: (1) The tension loop silently missing — if the burst does not author selfStatus 'High Tension' (35s on self), skill2's selfStatusEnd trigger is structurally dead and BOTH the team ATK▼ and the 20s self-stun vanish, flattering Sky by a large margin; a passing suite that never asserts a post-lapse event would not catch it. Demand an assertion anchored at burstCast+35s. (2) Stun dropped as 'defensive'. (3) ATK lines mis-based: both skill2 lines are '% of the skill user's ATK' (casterAtkPct, flat-resolved, one negative) while the burst self line is plain atkPct — three different encodings, easy to homogenize. (4) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter: the burst blocks are her own cast; the skill2 team buff is 'entering Full Burst' — they are DIFFERENT triggers in the same kit, so a uniform choice is wrong on one side. Fixture hazard: Sky is Burst I with cd 40s — controlComp fixes liter at B1, so a faithful test needs a comp where Sky actually casts (replace liter or assert the alternation), else burstCast blocks fire zero times and the whole tension loop is untested. Measurement gates (⛑): (a) whether burst recast at lapse+5s cancels Low Tension/stun early (literal 20s vs effective 5s — biggest open swing on her own output); (b) the 'Full Charge maintained 1+ sec' hold convention for the S1 trigger (first-proc phase). Defiant Spirit immunity is unmodeled; HYPOTHESIS: its 3 charges (re-armed only by the 5s 'not in Defiant Spirit' gate) are exhausted in the opening ~20s, before the first High-Tension lapse at ~cast+35s, so NOT modeling the immunity should not reduce the Low Tension debuff's modeled uptime — the driver should state this reconciliation, not just skip the line.
